'''2022 Decipher Cards Only Retro Event''' was a Players Committee Decipher-pool retro event on GEMP (Premiere through Theed Palace). [[Jonny Chu]] defeated [[Steve Baroni]] in the Final Confrontation (concession).<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-05-decipher-cards-only-retro-event/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' April–May 2022
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80902 forum]

== Decklists ==

Published Top 4 constructed lists. Finish order is the numbered standings in the GEMP importable-decklists forum topic ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80902 t=80902]): 1 Chu, 2 Baroni, 3 Desai, 4 Anis. [[Jonny Chu]] defeated [[Steve Baroni]] by concession in the Final Confrontation.
